description: .NET version upgrade plan from net8.0 to net10.0 for eShopOnWeb

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS release, offering extended support through 2028, improved performance, and access to modern .NET APIs. Upgrading from net8.0 to net10.0 ensures the project remains on a well-supported runtime and benefits from the latest platform improvements.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution from net8.0 to net10.0. This includes: updating the TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props and any individual .csproj files, updating the SDK version in global.json, upgrading all NuGet package references (Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Azure.*, and third-party packages) to versions compatible with net10.0, and resolving any breaking API changes between .NET 8 and .NET 10. All 10 projects must compile and all tests must pass after the upgrade.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded all 10 projects in eShopOnWeb from net8.0 to net10.0. Updated global.json SDK to 10.0.x, updated all package references (ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Azure SDK, AutoMapper), resolved breaking changes (SYSLIB0051, TimeSpan overload ambiguity, CS0433), and fixed xUnit assertions. Build: 0 errors. Tests: 74/74 passed.
